summary: Completed comprehensive testing of P0 features in iteration 3: Content Pages, PayU Gateway, Referral System, and Admin SMTP Settings. All 20 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed for all features. Fixed 2 bugs during testing.

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Footer link to Refunds page used /page/refunds but backend has key 'refund' (singular)
Missing 'Check' icon import from @phosphor-icons/react causing runtime error 'Check is not defined'

passed_tests: GET /api/content/terms returns Terms of Service content
GET /api/content/privacy returns Privacy Policy content
GET /api/content/refund returns Refund Policy content
GET /api/content/about returns About page content
GET /api/content/nonexistent returns 404
Content pages are publicly accessible without auth
POST /api/payu/initiate returns payment_url and form_data with hash
POST /api/payu/initiate requires authentication
POST /api/payu/initiate rejects invalid plan
POST /api/payu/initiate rejects free plan
GET /api/referral generates and returns referral code
GET /api/referral returns consistent code on subsequent calls
POST /api/referral/apply rejects invalid code with 404
POST /api/referral/apply rejects self-referral with 400
GET /api/referral requires authentication
GET /api/admin/smtp-settings returns SMTP config
PUT /api/admin/smtp-settings saves SMTP config
Admin SMTP endpoints require admin role
Admin login works with correct credentials
User registration works correctly
Landing page footer has Terms, Privacy, Refunds, About links
Content pages render with title and markdown content
Billing page shows Razorpay and PayU gateway selector
PayU gateway can be selected and shows 'Secure Payments via PayU'
Settings page shows referral code with copy button
Settings page shows referral stats (total/successful referrals)
Settings page shows 'Apply referral code' input for new users
Invalid referral code shows error toast
Admin Panel has Settings tab with SMTP Configuration form
SMTP form has all required fields (host, port, username, password, from_email, from_name, tls toggle)
SMTP settings can be saved successfully
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 features from iteration 3 are working: Content Pages (terms, privacy, refund, about), PayU payment gateway with selector toggle, Referral System with code generation and application, Admin SMTP settings. Two bugs were fixed during testing: 1) Landing.js footer link to refunds used wrong route, 2) Settings.js was missing Check icon import. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_p0_features.py.
